title: Indexed language
statement: For a predicate $p$ on pairs consisting of a Boolean string $x$ and a natural number $i$, the indexed language contains exactly those strings that encode a pair $(x,	ext{the binary expansion of }i)$ for which $p(x,i)$ holds.
